question: In which of the following states is the Statue of Unity situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Statue of Unity** is located in the state of **Gujarat**.
 
• It is a colossal statue of Indian statesman and independence activist **Vallabhbhai Patel**, who was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of independent India.
 
• The statue is situated on the **Narmada River** in the Kevadiya colony, facing the Sardar Sarovar Dam.
 
• Standing at a height of **182 meters** (597 feet), it is currently the **tallest statue in the world**.
 
• The Statue of Unity was inaugurated on **31st October 2018**, marking the 143rd birth anniversary of Sardar Patel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The statue was designed by Indian sculptor **Ram V. Sutar**.
 
• It was built by **Larsen & Toubro**, an Indian multinational conglomerate, at a cost of approximately **₹2,989 crore** (about USD 422 million).
 
• The project aimed to inspire generations by highlighting Sardar Patel's role in unifying the country.
 
• The site includes a museum, an exhibition hall, and a viewing gallery that offers a panoramic view of the surrounding region.
 
• The Statue of Unity has become a major tourist attraction, drawing visitors from all over the world.
